asm.configFile.description: Path to uttori-asm.config.json relative to the workspace root. When empty, uttori-asm.config.json is discovered automatically.

asm.plugins.description: Plugin module specifiers appended to plugins from uttori-asm.config.json. Workspace Trust is required.

asm.target.description: Target contribution ID or alias. The language server validates it against active plugin metadata.

asm.entryPoints.description: Project entry-point files (relative to the workspace root) analysed as include roots. When empty, each open file is treated as its own root.

asm.includePaths.description: Additional include search paths handed to the assembler. When empty, project configuration or target defaults apply.

asm.architecture.description: Architecture contribution ID or alias. The language server validates it against the selected target.

asm.buildOutput.description: Output path for the assembled binary. When empty, the selected target's default extension is used.

asm.baseImage.description: Optional base image file to patch when building.

asm.analysisProject.description: Native analysis-project directory or analysis.json path, absolute or relative to each workspace folder. When empty, up to 32 workspace analysis projects are discovered automatically.

asm.analysis.showAnnotations.description: Show aligned project-state and runtime analysis overlays in source editors. Toggle with the eye button beside Build Binary.
asm.analysis.showAnnotations.deprecationMessage: Use asm.editorInfo.inline.enabled. Explicit values remain supported when the replacement is unset.

asm.analysis.annotationColumn.description: Preferred minimum source column for analysis overlays. All visible overlays align beyond the longest annotated line with a three-column gap. Tab width follows the editor setting.
asm.analysis.annotationColumn.deprecationMessage: Use asm.editorInfo.inline.column and asm.editorInfo.inline.placement. Explicit values remain supported.

asm.analysis.maxWorkItems.description: Maximum static-analysis work items when regenerating disassembly. This limits CPU-state and call-path exploration, not imported trace events. Increase for larger analyses. Higher values require more time and memory. Incomplete analysis cannot discard known code.

asm.analysis.maxMemoryMiB.description: JavaScript heap budget in MiB for the isolated analysis-view process and each disassembly maintenance process. Increase for large analysis projects. Maintenance phases exit before the next starts. Views reuse a validated project cache. Total process memory may exceed the heap budget.

asm.trace.indexMode.description: Native SNES CPU captures default to the versioned decoder-state index: joint bytes, width/bank variants, exact counts and bus observations. Full register history requires an available capture archive. Other processors use full indexing.

asm.trace.maxImportSizeMiB.description: Maximum native runtime trace file size in MiB (2048 = 2 GiB). Set in the project workspace settings for unusually large captures. Trace chunks are read incrementally. Memory use also depends on the number of distinct execution observations. This is separate from the static-analysis work budget.

uttoriAsmLanguageServer.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Uttori Assembly language server.

asm.debug.captureSink.description: Lossless ACT2 destination: stream through the editor, or let the local ares runtime write binary chunks directly. Native file capture requires the capture-file runtime and a paused debugger when starting.

enumDescriptions: Live instruction trace with bounded buffering. Dropped events are reported.
Lossless fetched instruction bytes and CPU state, saved to ACT2 for disassembly import. Requires the capture-v2 ares runtime.
Lossless CPU/DMA/HDMA bus accesses with timing, channel and transfer phase, saved to ACT2 for bus activity import. Requires the capture-bus ares runtime.

Lossless bus accesses plus explicit DMA run and HDMA payload-burst boundaries and channel snapshots. Requires the capture-transfer runtime. Imports show completed, interrupted and partial transfer windows.
Lossless bus and transfer capture with verified VRAM/CGRAM/OAM write destinations, blocked writes and latch-only outcomes, including during rendering. Requires the capture-ppu runtime.
asm.debug.traceMode.description: Runtime trace recording mode. Lossless modes slow emulation while storage drains and require a matching ares runtime. Instruction and bus capture are separate streams. Bus mode does not include fetched instruction bytes or full CPU registers.

asm.debug.traceDetail.description: Full capture requires a runtime supplying execution-time instruction bytes, registers and bus accesses. Unsupported runtimes are rejected. Select pc explicitly to record addresses only. Both modes use bounded buffers and report dropped events.

asm.analysis.cacheMaxMiB.description: Disposable SQL projection budget in MiB, applied after imports or explicit storage maintenance. Editor/export indexes remain available.

asm.analysis.storageMaxMiB.description: Maximum live SQLite page allocation for new publications in MiB; 0 disables the ceiling. An exceeded budget rolls back the entire publication.

asm.debug.liveBusAnalysis.description: Analyze native-file bus captures in an isolated process while recording. Shows provisional activity and publishes facts to the selected matching project after complete validation.

asm.debug.liveBusMaxLagMiB.description: Maximum unread durable capture backlog for live bus analysis, in MiB. Exceeding it stops analysis while native recording continues. Import the final archive offline.

asm.debug.captureContext.description: Include paused start/end WRAM, a pre-action state, controller replay data, visual milestones, and a separate two-frame PPU/bus capture. Requires a matching local ares runtime. Disable only for bare trace capture.

asm.editorInfo.preset.description: Default fields for editor information. Explicit inline parts and hover rows override the preset.

asm.editorInfo.inline.enabled.description: Show source information inline. Explicit legacy asm.analysis.showAnnotations is honored when this setting is unset. Hover is controlled separately.

asm.editorInfo.inline.parts.description: Ordered templates for inline information. Omit to use the preset; [] hides all parts. Fields: output_offsets, output_offset_cpu, output_offset_file, output_bytes, output_size, operand_value, operand_values, execution_observations, execution_counts, execution_count_cpu, project_state.FIELD, runtime_state.FIELD. Use ${field}; $${ escapes a literal ${. Missing values omit the whole part. No color or executable expressions.

asm.editorInfo.inline.placement.description: Align short lines at the configured column. Longer lines place information after their own source without shifting other overlays. Use afterLine for a three-column gap on every line.

asm.editorInfo.inline.column.description: Preferred minimum zero-based column in aligned mode. Honors explicit legacy asm.analysis.annotationColumn when unset.

asm.editorInfo.inline.color.patternErrorMessage: Enter a hex color such as #FFA65C or a VS Code theme color such as editorWarning.foreground.
asm.editorInfo.inline.color.description: Color for the entire inline overlay. Accepts #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, or a VS Code theme color identifier (for example editorWarning.foreground). Theme colors follow the active theme.

asm.editorInfo.inline.maxCharacters.description: Total character budget for one source line, including all contexts and truncation marker.

asm.editorInfo.hover.enabled.description: Append compact source information to hover. Instruction documentation remains unchanged.

asm.editorInfo.hover.rows.description: Ordered hover-row templates, using the same ${field} placeholders as inline parts. Omit for preset defaults; [] hides analysis rows. Missing fields suppress the entire row.

asm.buildTarget.description: Target for Build, Run, Debug and Watch. Baseline verifies exact equality; modified applies owned replacement ranges. Configured retains the normal assembly project.

asm.modificationProject.description: Path to modification.json, absolute or relative to the first workspace folder. Owned inputs survive baseline regeneration.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Built-in assembly support remains available, but workspace plugin modules and uttori-asm.config.json are disabled until the workspace is trusted.
